summary.allegation: The cardholder says they ordered clothing on 22 March 2025 and the package never arrived, and that two contacts with the merchant produced no resolution, so they claim GBP 189.99 under Visa 13.1.
summary.to_defend: The merchant must show proof of delivery, with carrier, tracking number and delivery confirmation to the cardholder's address on or before the chargeback date.

requirements.title: Proof of delivery
requirements.text: Proof of delivery: tracking number, carrier name, and confirmation of delivery to the cardholder's address.
requirements.finding: Royal Mail tracking RM98421144GB shows the item posted 23 March 2025 from Leeds and delivered and signed for at SW4 7QR on 24 March 2025, with signature on file; the merchant order record repeats the same carrier and tracking number.

requirements.title: Service rendered
requirements.text: For services: evidence the service was rendered on or before the expected date (booking confirmation, attendance log, access logs).
requirements.finding: This is a physical goods purchase of a wool overcoat from a clothing retailer (MCC 5651) shipped via Royal Mail, so there is no service component to evidence.

requirements.title: Delivered before chargeback date
requirements.text: Date of delivery / service rendered is on or before the chargeback date.
requirements.finding: Delivery is recorded on 24 March 2025 at 11:47, two days after the 22 March 2025 purchase and well before the chargeback was raised.

justification: Represent: R1 is met by Royal Mail tracking RM98421144GB showing a signed delivery to the cardholder's own address, and R3 and R4 follow from the same record.
rationale:
The cardholder claims a GBP 189.99 clothing order placed 22 March 2025 never arrived.
Royal Mail tracking RM98421144GB shows order #NT-44912 posted 23 March 2025 and delivered, signed by WHITFORD, at 11:47 on 24 March 2025.
Delivery was made to 22 Cavendish Court, London SW4 7QR, the same address given as billing and shipping at purchase, and the postcode matches the transaction record with AVS Y.
The transaction was authenticated by 3DS with CVV match, supporting that the genuine cardholder placed the order.
Delivery on 24 March 2025 precedes the 18 April 2025 chargeback, so all applicable 13.1 requirements are met.
